external_gamecraft_bench_audit.official_verifier_requirements: Each of the 140 tasks provides a natural-language game specification (`instruction.md`), a `tests/rubric.json`, and an oracle reference project (`solution/files/`), rather than a formal state-transition contract. Its official scorer (`gamecraft_bench.verifier`) replays agent-authored demonstration traces under Xvfb + xdotool + ffmpeg (`x11grab`) and calls an external multimodal vision-language model (`GAMECRAFT_BENCH_JUDGE`) over recorded video frames (148.5M-2.24B LLM tokens per 140-task agent run). To isolate deterministic Form-to-Godot compiler parity without external VLM variance, GE-H9 executes 36 deterministic gameplay tasks (2 across each of GameCraft-Bench's 15 families plus 6 reference/multiplayer systems) directly inside headless Godot 4.7.2.
